source_article_text: Lydon Borough, 13 March 2025 — The Lydon Borough Regeneration Office issued the Old Quay Renewal Framework on 12 March. It requires projects in the Old Quay area to retain occupied workshops where feasible and to provide a public-access plan for any redeveloped waterfront parcel. On 1 April 2025, Lydon Borough Council will make an £8.4 million capital fund available for eligible building repairs, street improvements, and the conversion of vacant industrial premises; individual awards may not exceed £1.2 million. Applications to the Regeneration Office open on 5 May and must be submitted by 20 June 2025. The council expects to announce awards by 15 August, and the Lydon Municipal Works Unit is scheduled to begin enabling works on 1 September 2025.
